description: Frozen key set for every golden (grilled decisions 10 and 14). Each golden is a value-level JSON projection, `jq -S`-normalised, of a script's decision fields; Phase 2/3 assert key-set equality against this file, so a subset projection cannot weaken a golden. `rows` is null except for classification scripts, where it is an array of {version,status,note,prev} objects compared after sorting by version (`prev` added round-2 review-gauntlet, decision D2: the resolved Audit PREV tag name, or null, reused verbatim by SKILL.md's A2.5 compare_line_label field per audit-inference.md's field contract). exit_code vocabulary (decision 20): 0 ok, 1 validation failure, 2 environment failure.
